headline: Fiona The Hippo Dies At The Cincinnati Zoo After Eating A Hat
seoTitle: Fiona The Hippo Dies At The Cincinnati Zoo
metaDescription: Fiona, the widely recognized hippopotamus at the Cincinnati Zoo & Botanical Garden, has died following complications from ingesting a visitor's hat.
aiSummaryBullets: Fiona the hippo died at the Cincinnati Zoo after swallowing a knitted hat that fell into her habitat.
Veterinary staff attempted several medical interventions, including a colonoscopy and the use of a vibration plate, to help the animal.
The hippopotamus, named after a character from the film Shrek, gained international attention after being born prematurely at the facility.
aiContextParagraph: Fiona, a hippopotamus residing at the Cincinnati Zoo & Botanical Garden, has died after ingesting a visitor's knitted hat. Known globally as a social media sensation, Fiona originally gained public attention due to her premature birth, which led to significant early-life survival efforts by zoo staff. She was famously named after the character from the animated movie series Shrek. Following the incident in which the item fell into her enclosure, zoo veterinarians and animal care teams attempted a series of medical procedures to assist her in passing the obstruction. These interventions included the use of a vibration plate and a colonoscopy. Despite these extensive efforts to remove the object, the zoo announced that the animal did not survive. The loss of the hippo has been reported by various international news organizations, noting her status as one of the most recognizable zoo animals in the United States.
whyItIsViral: The story is widely covered by three independent outlets due to the animal's significant public profile and following.
